## What changed?

Describe the documentation, link or template change and why it helps PetCompanion users.

## Related issue or discussion

Link it here, if there is one.

## Checks

- [ ] I previewed the Markdown or checked the form/template syntax.
- [ ] I checked the relevant links.
- [ ] The text describes publicly available features and keeps unreleased plans out.
- [ ] I included no saves, notebook entries, backups, credentials or personal information.
- [ ] I included no application source, installers, dependencies or generated build folders.
- [ ] Any attached material is mine to share, with permission/attribution explained where needed.
- [ ] I followed the [contribution guide](https://github.com/MagicJocey/petcompanion-releases/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/MagicJocey/petcompanion-releases/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Validation

Explain what you checked. For a wording-only change, a Markdown preview is enough.
